title: Synthetic historical note
text: A model generated an SVG pelican above a bicycle. The long bill was visible, but the feet did not contact the pedals and the rear wheel was disconnected. The author praised the recognisable silhouette and criticised the riding relation.

title: Synthetic agentic note
text: An agent inspected a contact sheet, consulted a pelican anatomy reference, moved the body onto the saddle, connected both wheels to the frame and preserved numbered SVG revisions. The third revision improved anatomy but introduced an extra pedal.

title: Synthetic tuk-tuk note
text: The pelican was drawn on top of the tuk-tuk rather than in the driver position. Although the three wheels and cabin were recognisable, the image represented riding-on rather than driving.
